title: Same Words, Different Answers: Segmentation Sensitivity of LLM-Derived Views (artifact)
description: Code, preregistration, cached model outputs and scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure of the ICDE 2027 Experiment, Analysis and Benchmark submission 'Same Words, Different Answers: Segmentation Sensitivity of LLM-Derived Views'. Source corpora (AMI Meeting Corpus audio and annotations, Wikipedia text) are not redistributed; scripts download them.
